lines.en: All of the bad things in all of the world are not unfortunate coincidences nor byproducts of the timelines we find ourselves in.
lines.zh: 世界上所有的坏事,既不是不幸的巧合,也不是我们所处的时间线带来的副产品。

lines.en: They are the divine retribution of comedic false gods who only exist during times in which we’re forced to call upon them to solve problems we simply can not.
lines.zh: 它们是那些滑稽伪神的报应——而这些神,只在我们被迫呼唤他们去解决我们根本解决不了的问题时才存在。

lines.en: But those calls are met with laughter.
lines.zh: 可那些呼唤得到的回应,是笑声。

lines.en: And that laughter not only pierces the innermost sections of our ears but drills holes into our skulls so wide and so malformed that we can’t help but focus on them for far longer than we should.
lines.zh: 而那笑声不只刺穿我们耳朵最深的地方,还在我们的头骨上钻出又宽又畸形的洞,让我们忍不住盯着它们看,看得比该看的久得多。
越专注,就越难受。

lines.en: Not just to live and breathe and walk...but to think and hear and see.
lines.zh: 不只是活着、呼吸、走路……还有思考、听见、看见。

lines.en: If it were not for these comedies and the entertainment of anthropomorphized xoana who take on life only when looked at, things would be far too simple.
lines.zh: 若不是有这些闹剧,还有那些被人格化、只有被注视时才活过来的木像供人取乐,一切就会简单得太过分了。

lines.en: Gods can not exist if there is no one there to scorn them, just as I can not exist if there is no one here to scorn me.
lines.zh: 没有人去讥讽,神就无从存在;正如这里没有人讥讽我,我也无从存在。

lines.en: And to think that just moments ago I seriously contemplated praying.
lines.zh: 想想就在片刻之前,我还认真地考虑过要祈祷。
向谁祈祷?

lines.en: Another wooden idol inside another glass case somewhere- staring back at me with hollow sockets where its eyes should be? Immortalized by a small plaque and more locks than necessary to guard a piece of wood?
lines.zh: 又一个被关在又一处玻璃柜里的木偶——用本该长着眼睛的空窟窿回望着我?被一块小小的铭牌和远远超出必要的锁供奉起来,只为看守一块木头?

lines.en: We could not capture gods, so we created our own.
lines.zh: 我们抓不住神,于是自己造了神。

lines.en: We gave them stories and names and, in turn, lives.
lines.zh: 我们给了他们故事和名字,也就给了他们生命。

lines.en: But once those lives became too powerful they took everything from us, and now I can’t even walk a block down the fucking street without subconsciously damning them for their poor sense of humor.
lines.zh: 可一旦那些生命变得太强大,他们就把一切从我们手里夺走了,而现在,我他妈的连走过一个街区的路,都会下意识地诅咒他们那糟糕透顶的幽默感。

lines.en: This was not meant to happen.
lines.zh: 这本不该发生。

lines.en: I should be the one still lost.
lines.zh: 该是那个还在迷路的人,应该是我。

lines.en: Ayane and Maya should be the ones embracing on top of the school rooftop...and me?
lines.zh: 该在学校天台上相拥的是 Ayane 和 Maya……而我呢?

lines.en: I should be locked in a box.
lines.zh: 我该被锁在一个盒子里。

lines.en: I should be locked in a box and only taken out to be glanced over and mocked, rather than being the one who holds the key to unlock all of the boxes in-
lines.zh: 我该被锁在盒子里,只有在被人取出来瞥一眼、嘲笑一通时才露面,而不是那个握着钥匙、能打开所有盒子的人——
对了……
盒子……

lines.en: : So...is there anywhere you think we should go first?
lines.zh: : 那么……你觉得我们先去哪儿好?

lines.en: : I figured the shrine might be a good idea. It would probably be best to check the places Maya regularly visits before doing anything else.
lines.zh: : 我猜神社可能是个不错的主意。在做别的之前,最好先去查查 Maya 常去的地方。
: 我觉得……

lines.en: : I think we should go back to the dorms.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们应该回宿舍。

lines.en: : The dorms?...But I already told you I checked there. No one was left in any of the rooms.
lines.zh: : 宿舍?……可我说过了,我查过那里了。所有房间都没剩下人。
: 只是……一种感觉。

lines.en: : Even if we don’t find Maya, I think there might be something that could give us some sort of hint.
lines.zh: : 就算找不到 Maya,我觉得那里也许有什么能给我们一点线索。

lines.en: : A hint? Like...a note or something?
lines.zh: : 线索?比如……一张纸条什么的?
: 或者类似的东西。

lines.en: : If she’s not there, we can check the shrine. I’m just feeling a little too pissed off at the gods right now to grace them with my presence.
lines.zh: : 如果她不在,我们再去神社。只是我现在对那些神火大得很,不想赏脸去见他们。

lines.en: : We’ll find her...don’t worry. Getting mad at the gods probably isn’t going to do us any favors right now.
lines.zh: : 我们会找到她的……别担心。跟神置气,现在大概对我们没什么好处。

lines.en: : I don’t blame you for feeling that way, though. Even I’m a little mad right now, and I barely ever get angry.
lines.zh: : 不过我不怪你这么想。就连我现在也有点生气,而我几乎从不生气。

lines.en: : Well, you should. Anger is good for you. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你该生气。生气对你有好处。算是吧。

lines.en: : Just don’t get angry at me.
lines.zh: : 只是别冲我生气。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Sensei...In fact, if there’s anyone I should have a reason to be mad at right now, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 我不知道,Sensei……事实上,如果现在有谁是我有理由生气的,那就是你。

lines.en: : Here we are, {i}basically dating,{/i} and I find out you’re in love with one of my best friends. That seems like a good reason to get angry, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我们俩{i}基本算是在交往{/i}了,结果我发现你爱上了我最好的朋友之一。这听起来是个不错的生气理由,不是吗?

lines.en: : I’m not {i}in love{/i} with anyone, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 我没有{i}爱上{/i}任何人,Ayane……
: 连我也没有?……
: 这个……

lines.en: : I didn’t mean it like that.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Do you want to know what I think, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 想知道我怎么想的吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Sure. It would be nice to learn a little more about you during our last days on earth.
lines.zh: : 当然。在我们在地球上的最后几天里,能多了解你一点也挺好。

lines.en: : I think the problem is that you just don’t understand love.
lines.zh: : 我觉得问题在于,你只是不懂爱。
: 嗯……这点你说得没——
: 我还没说完。

lines.en: : What I was going to say next is that not understanding love doesn’t mean you don’t {i}feel{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 我接下来要说的是,不懂爱并不代表你{i}感受{/i}不到爱。

lines.en: : I know for a fact you love me. And Ami. And Maya. And probably a bunch of other girls too.
lines.zh: : 我很确定你爱我。还有 Ami。还有 Maya。大概还有一堆别的女孩。

lines.en: : And while I’d definitely prefer a monogamous relationship, I’m not going to fault you for the things you feel, even {i}if{/i} you can’t put those feelings into words.
lines.zh: : 虽然我当然更想要一段一对一的关系,但我不会因为你感受到的东西而责怪你,{i}哪怕{/i}你说不出那些感受。

lines.en: : Especially because I also think that, one day...you’ll figure that part out.
lines.zh: : 尤其是因为我还觉得,总有一天……你会弄明白那一部分。

lines.en: : And that all of those things you tell yourself about how you’re not meant to love or be loved will sound flat out silly.
lines.zh: : 到那时,你告诉自己的那些「我天生就不该爱人、也不该被爱」的话,听上去会蠢得不能再蠢。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’ll be the one with you {i}when{/i} you figure it out...or if it will be someone like Maya instead...
lines.zh: : 我不知道你弄明白的{i}那天{/i},陪在你身边的会是我……还是会是 Maya 那样的人……

lines.en: : But I hope you’ll get to accept and understand what it means to be in love one day.
lines.zh: : 但我希望有一天,你能接受并理解,爱上一个人到底意味着什么。

lines.en: : Because it really is the greatest feeling in the world.
lines.zh: : 因为那真的是世界上最美好的感觉。

lines.en: Despite still not understanding the rationale, Ayane doesn’t put up a fight when it comes to heading over to the dorms- especially since it will finally give her an opportunity to change out of her pajamas.
lines.zh: 尽管还是不理解其中的道理,Ayane 并没有反对去宿舍——尤其是这样她终于有机会把睡衣换掉了。

lines.en: And while I don’t expect to find Maya there given that the place has already been searched {i}once,{/i} having some sort of...starting point might help in locating her.
lines.zh: 虽然那地方已经被搜过{i}一次{/i},我并不指望能在那里找到 Maya,但有个……起点,也许有助于定位她。

lines.en: And if there are any of those mystery boxes left in her room, I’ll finally be able to open one up without facing any immediate consequences.
lines.zh: 而且如果她房间里还剩下那些神秘的盒子,我终于能打开一个,而不必立刻承担什么后果。

lines.en: It’s just unfortunate that it took her disappearance and the slow realization that I might not ever see {i}her{/i} again for me to be able to do that.
lines.zh: 只可惜,要等到{i}她{/i}消失、等我慢慢意识到也许再也见不到她,我才能这么做。

lines.en: Memories are silly, the way they come and go.
lines.zh: 记忆这种东西真傻,说来就来,说走就走。

lines.en: And nostalgia’s like a blanket of softest, whitest snow.
lines.zh: 而怀旧像一床最柔软、最洁白的雪。

lines.en: But winter’s dead, the snow is gone, and all that’s left is woe.
lines.zh: 可冬天死了,雪也化了,剩下的只有悲哀。

lines.en: So if my memories are next to die, you can say I told you so.
lines.zh: 所以如果下一个要死掉的是我的记忆,你可以说,我早说过。

lines.en: : So...what is it we’re looking for again? A...note or something?
lines.zh: : 那么……我们到底在找什么来着?一张……纸条什么的?
: 什么都行。

lines.en: : Maya keeps a bunch of sketchy boxes near the foot of her bed that I think might have some sort of...hint or something in them.
lines.zh: : Maya 床尾放着一堆可疑的盒子,我觉得里面可能有某种……线索之类的。

lines.en: : At least that’s the only logical conclusion I can draw at the moment pertaining to why she always has me carry them to the school in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 至少这是我现在能得出的唯一合理解释——解释她为什么总要我在半夜把它们搬到学校去。
: 她……什么?

lines.en: : Also, we were just at the school. Why didn’t you look while we were there?
lines.zh: : 还有,我们刚才就在学校。你当时怎么不找?

lines.en: : Easy. I didn’t think of it until we were already halfway here.
lines.zh: : 简单。走到半路我才想起来。

lines.en: : Sensei, I love you, but for both of our sakes, I really hope you get better at this whole “end of the world” thing.
lines.zh: : Sensei,我爱你,但为了我们俩好,我真希望你能快点摸清「世界末日」这一套。

lines.en: : Hey, don’t take it out on me just because you’re weirdly cool and comfortable with all of this.
lines.zh: : 嘿,别因为你对这一切莫名其妙地淡定自若,就把气撒在我身上。

lines.en: : I’m not comfortable at all. I’m horrified.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不淡定。我吓得要死。

lines.en: : It’s just that being next to you makes that okay.
lines.zh: : 只是,待在你身边让我觉得没关系。

lines.en: : And that as long as you don’t leave my sight again for the rest of our lives, I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 而且只要余生你都不再离开我的视线,我就没事。

lines.en: : Right. Well, on that note, it’s time we get to searching.
lines.zh: : 好吧。说到这个,我们该开始找了。

lines.en: : Come on, Ayane. If we’re going to the shrine after this, we need to-
lines.zh: : 走吧,Ayane。如果之后还要去神社,我们得——

lines.en: : I guess I can start by checking on the kotatsu for any notes she may have left if you want to start going through her boxes.
lines.zh: : 那我去被炉那边看看她有没有留下什么纸条,你这边就开始翻她的盒子吧。

lines.en: : Oh, and I’ll handle going through her clothes and her pockets and stuff since I’m not really comfortable with the idea of-
lines.zh: : 哦,还有她的衣服和口袋什么的我来翻,因为我实在不太能接受——
: 她就在那里。
: 什么?在哪儿?我没——

lines.en: : She’s right there on the bed.
lines.zh: : 她就在床上。
: 她就在那里。

lines.en: : Hey, if...if this is some kind of joke...it’s not really funny, Sensei. I’m already scared enough.
lines.zh: : 喂,如果……如果这是什么玩笑……这一点都不好笑,Sensei。我已经够害怕了。
: Sens-

lines.en: : Do you really not see her?
lines.zh: : 你真的看不见她?
: 她就在那里。
: Ayane……
: 她就在那里。
: 我……什么都没看见……
神在此处

lines.en: YOUR TRANSGRESSIONS CLING TO THE WALLS OF THIS ROOM LIKE SMOKE
lines.zh: 你的罪孽像烟一样黏在这间屋子的墙上

lines.en: THAT WHICH YOU HAVE DEFILED APPEARS BEFORE {b}YOU{/b} BUT NO ONE ELSE
lines.zh: 你所玷污之物显现在你眼前,却只显现给{b}你{/b}一个人
最后的临别赠礼

lines.en: IS THIS THE LIFE OF PRIZES YOU HAVE WISHED FOR???
lines.zh: 这就是你许愿要的奖品人生吗???
你在这里开心吗???
告诉我
告诉我你看见我了
把你知道的一切都告诉我

lines.en: TELL ME HOW IT FELT TO BE ROOTED TO THE GROUND
lines.zh: 告诉我被钉在地上的感觉是什么样的

lines.en: TELL ME THE THINGS YOU THINK OF WHEN YOU GO TO SLEEP AT NIGHT
lines.zh: 告诉我你夜里入睡前想的那些事
我想知道

lines.en: I WANT TO KNOW EVERYTHING ABOUT YOU
lines.zh: 我想知道关于你的一切
我是那么那么感兴趣

lines.en: SO VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY VERY INTERESTED
lines.zh: 那么那么那么那么那么那么那么那么感兴趣

lines.en: I WILL BE IGNORED NO LONGER
lines.zh: 我不会再被无视了

lines.en: TOUCH THESE CALLOUSED HANDS THAT REACH FOR YOU AND ONLY YOU
lines.zh: 摸摸这双长满老茧的手,它们只为你、只为你伸出

lines.en: OPEN YOUR EYES AND LET IN THE NIGHT
lines.zh: 睁开眼,让夜色进来

lines.en: YOU CAN SEE THE THINGS THAT THEY CAN NOT
lines.zh: 你能看见他们看不见的东西
你明白吗???
你终于明白了吗???

lines.en: : Sensei...maybe we should just go to the shrine now? It’s clear you’re not feeling well and-
lines.zh: : Sensei……也许我们现在就该去神社?你明显不太舒服,而且——

lines.en: : Sensei, please! This is getting really, really weird!
lines.zh: : Sensei,求你了!这变得真的、真的很诡异!

lines.en: Maya lies on the bed, brow furrowed and twitching every seven seconds as the chemicals dancing around in the deepest parts of her brain cause her to see things I can not see myself.
lines.zh: Maya 躺在床上,眉头紧锁,每七秒抽搐一次,她大脑最深处那些翻腾的化学物质正让她看见我自己看不见的东西。

lines.en: Behind me is another girl, now on the verge of breaking into tears as I speak to someone I can see but she can not.
lines.zh: 我身后是另一个女孩,此刻几乎要哭出来了,因为我正在跟一个我看得见、她却看不见的人说话。

lines.en: I wonder to myself if this is what it’s like for everyone.
lines.zh: 我暗自发想,是不是每个人都是这样。

lines.en: If every other bed has another sleeping girl inside of it and that no one has disappeared at all.
lines.zh: 是不是别的每一张床上都躺着另一个熟睡的女孩,而根本没有人消失过。

lines.en: But I am too absorbed in the prospect of saving this one to check on any of the others.
lines.zh: 但我太专注于救下这一个,顾不上去查看其他人。
我必须救她。

lines.en: I have to save her so I can fix her.
lines.zh: 我必须救她,这样我才能修好她。

lines.en: I have to fix her because that is my job.
lines.zh: 我必须修好她,因为那是我的职责。

lines.en: I have to fix her because she needs to be fixed.
lines.zh: 我必须修好她,因为她需要被修好。
: Sensei……求你了……回到这边来……

lines.en: : H-Here! I’ll even open the box for you! It’s-
lines.zh: : 那……那这样!我甚至帮你把盒子打开!它——
: Maya。
: 等等……什么?

lines.en: : Sensei, come look at this. This box has-
lines.zh: : Sensei,快来看这个。这个盒子里有——
: Maya,醒醒。

lines.en: : You’re supposed to be on the roof right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在应该待在天台上。
: Maya,醒醒。
: 醒醒。
: 醒醒。

lines.en: : Sensei, seriously. I think this might actually-
lines.zh: : Sensei,说真的。我觉得这可能真的——

lines.en: I reach out and touch her.
lines.zh: 我伸出手,碰了她。
: 什么鬼?……
: 什么鬼?……
: 这是……
: 这是……
: 这他妈怎么可能。

lines.en: : Oh, Maya! You’re back early. I thought you went to take a shower?
lines.zh: : 哦,Maya!你回来得真早。我还以为你去洗澡了?

lines.en: : Sensei was just going over the Japanese homework with me since that’s the only thing you’re actually better than me at.
lines.zh: : Sensei 刚在陪我过日语作业,毕竟那是你唯一真正比我强的地方。

lines.en: : You’re free to join in but, like you said earlier, I am “annoying and intrusive,” so I would understand if you want to sit this out and study on your own.
lines.zh: : 你想一起也行,不过就像你之前说的,我「又烦人又爱管闲事」,所以你要是想这回就算了、自己复习,我也能理解。

lines.en: : I’m only going to be here for an hour today, though. So if you’re not going to join in, please let me have Sensei to myself and you can get him back once my mom comes to pick me up.
lines.zh: : 不过我今天只待一个小时。所以如果你不打算加入,请把 Sensei 让给我一个人,等我妈来接我的时候,你再把他领回去。
: 就是这个意思。我也这么认为,Sensei。

lines.en: : What the fuck is going on here?
lines.zh: : 这他妈到底是怎么回事?
: 嗯?你什么意思?

lines.en: : I mean what the fuck is going on here?!
lines.zh: : 我就是问,这他妈到底是怎么回事?!

lines.en: : Woah. Calm down there, cranky-pants. I always have lessons at this time. Just because you don’t like me doesn’t mean I’m going to stop coming.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。冷静点,暴脾气小姐。我这个时间一向有课。你不喜欢我,不代表我就不来了。

lines.en: : I do not give a shit about you, Noriko! I want to know how I got here! How is this happening?!
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不在乎你,Noriko!我想知道我是怎么到这儿来的!这到底是怎么发生的?!

lines.en: : You probably just...walked or something? How am I supposed to know how you got here?
lines.zh: : 你大概就是……走过来的什么的吧?我怎么会知道你是怎么来的?
: 我不明白。

lines.en: : I don’t understand what you’re saying.
lines.zh: : 我听不懂你在说什么。

lines.en: : I’m telling you I don’t fucking understand! I don’t understand any of this!
lines.zh: : 我告诉你,我他妈就是不明白!这一切我全都不明白!

lines.en: : You’re not real! Neither of you are real! None of this is fucking real!
lines.zh: : 你不是真的!你们俩都不是真的!这一切他妈的都不是真的!

lines.en: : Maya, come on. Do you really have to start getting existential {i}now{/i} of all times? I already told you that I’m only here for an hour today.
lines.zh: : Maya,别这样。你非得偏偏赶在{i}这个时候{/i}开始搞存在主义吗?我说过了,我今天只待一个小时。

lines.en: : I get that we’re the {i}gifted{/i} kids and stuff, but you really need to lay off all of those weird “Nothing is real” monologues if you’re ever going to make it anywhere in life.
lines.zh: : 我知道我们算是{i}有天分{/i}的孩子什么的,但你要是还想在人生里混出点名堂,真该少来那套「一切都不是真的」的怪独白。

lines.en: : There’s no way I’m actually back...right?
lines.zh: : 我不可能真的回来了……对吧?

lines.en: : This is a dream. This is all just a dream.
lines.zh: : 这是梦。这一切都只是梦。

lines.en: : You’re not him. You can’t be. I don’t believe it.
lines.zh: : 你不是他。你不可能是。我不信。

lines.en: : None of this is actually happening. Any minute, I’m going to wake up...and I’m going to go back to the roof, and I’m going to see him and...
lines.zh: : 这一切都根本没有在发生。随时,我都会醒来……然后回到天台,然后见到他,然后……
: 然后……

lines.en: : And he’s going to look at me. The {i}real{/i} me. The one that grew up.
lines.zh: : 然后他会看着我。看着{i}真正{/i}的我。那个长大了的版本。

lines.en: : The one that stopped coming here as soon as you did. The one that’s followed you all this time.
lines.zh: : 那个你一走就不再来这里的版本。那个一路追着你到现在的版本。

lines.en: : You’re not him. There’s no way you’re him.
lines.zh: : 你不是他。你不可能是他。

lines.en: : But then why does this hurt so fucking much?!
lines.zh: : 可那为什么这么他妈的疼?!
: 我不懂。

lines.en: : I am telling you...I do not fucking get it.
lines.zh: : 我告诉你……我他妈就是不懂。

lines.en: : STOP USING HIS FUCKING VOICE! YOU HAVEN’T EARNED IT!
lines.zh: : 别再用他妈的他的声音说话了!你还不配!

lines.en: : YOU HAVEN’T BEEN THROUGH WHAT HE’S BEEN THROUGH! WHAT {i}WE{/i} HAVE BEEN THROUGH!
lines.zh: : 你没经历过他经历过的事!没经历过{i}我们{/i}一起经历过的事!
: 你不是真的!

lines.en: : No! No no no no no no no no no no!
lines.zh: : 不!不不不不不不不不不不!

lines.en: : Send me back! I want to go back!
lines.zh: : 送我回去!我要回去!

lines.en: : This is not what I wished for!
lines.zh: : 这不是我许的愿!

lines.en: : What?! What are you trying to say to me in that stolen fucking voice?!
lines.zh: : 什么?!你用那副偷来的他妈的嗓子,到底想跟我说什么?!
: zdnh xs

lines.en: : Again, I can’t fucking understand you!
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,我他妈听不懂你!
: Maya,他是——

lines.en: : Get the fuck out of here, Noriko! The last person I want showing up in my nightmares is fucking {i}you!{/i}
lines.zh: : 给我滚出去,Noriko!我的噩梦里最不想出现的人就是{i}你{/i}!

lines.en: : Nightmares? Wait, do you think you’re dreaming right now? Is {i}that{/i} why you’re so cranky today?
lines.zh: : 噩梦?等等,你觉得你现在是在做梦?{i}所以{/i}你今天才这么暴躁?
: zdnh xs

lines.en: : Maya, Sensei is trying to tell you to-
lines.zh: : Maya,Sensei 是想告诉你——

lines.en: : SHUT THE FUCK UP! I DON’T NEED YOUR HELP!
lines.zh: : 给我闭嘴!我不需要你帮忙!

lines.en: : Oh, I know that. You’ve never needed my help before.
lines.zh: : 哦,这我知道。你从来就不需要我帮忙。

lines.en: : In fact, you’ve never needed {i}anyone’s{/i} help before, right? At least that’s what you’re always saying.
lines.zh: : 事实上,你从来没需要过{i}任何人{/i}的帮助,对吧?至少你一直是这么说的。

lines.en: : But we both know that deep down, you’re basically begging to be coddled and-
lines.zh: : 可我们俩心里都清楚,在内心深处,你基本上就是在求着被人哄——
: zdnh xs

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sorry, Sensei. I’ll wait my turn and let Maya finish getting this little temper tantrum out of her system before we pick back up.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。抱歉,Sensei。我排队等着,让 Maya 把这通小脾气发完,我们再来。
: zdnh xs
: zdnh xs
: zdnh xs
: 这就是地狱,对吧?

lines.en: : A life trapped inside of this room without the one thing in it that managed to keep me sane?
lines.zh: : 一辈子被困在这个房间里,而房间里唯一能让我保持清醒的东西却不在了?

lines.en: : Is this what I get for defying God?
lines.zh: : 这就是我违抗神的下场?

lines.en: : Is this what I get for falling in love?!
lines.zh: : 这就是我恋爱的下场?!
: zdnh xs
: zdnh xs

lines.en: : Fuck you! Fuck you, fuck you, fuck you! Send me back! Send me back right now!
lines.zh: : 去你的!去你的、去你的、去你的!送我回去!现在就送我回去!
: zdnh xs
: 住口!
: zdnh xs
: 住口!
: zdnh xs
: 求你了——
: zdnh xs
: 他妈的——
: zdnh xs
